title: PROJECT LEADER
desc:
About Us
Altan Hidrolik is a Tier-1 OEM fluid technology company based in İstanbul (Tuzla) with close to 40 years of engineering heritage. Beyond hose and tube assemblies, fittings and welded subsystems, we design and deliver complete hydraulic, pneumatic and thermal systems for land and naval platforms and OEM vehicles - from concept and design through prototype, qualification, serial production and field support, all under one roof. Our work is backed by a government-certified R Center and EYDEP B Level, IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 and TISAX certifications. Türkiye's leading defense industry OEMs are among our system customers.
The Role
We are looking for a Project Leader to own the system projects of our Projects, Design & Engineering (PTM) department end-to-end. The portfolio is predominantly defense industry programs for land and naval platforms, alongside selected commercial vehicle and machinery OEM projects.
You will be the company's face to the customer in this segment - their single point of contact from RFQ and contract award through design reviews, qualification, acceptance, serial delivery and after-sales. Internally, you will be the bridge between the PTM team, our Purchasing, Planning, Production, Logistics and Quality departments, and our suppliers - turning contractual requirements into an executable plan and keeping every party on schedule. A Project Engineer will support you in day-to-day internal follow-up.
These are technically demanding, long-duration projects with contractual milestones, acceptance criteria and penalty clauses. We are looking for someone comfortable carrying that accountability.
What You Will Do
Act as the customer's single point of contact: lead kick-off meetings, design reviews (PDR/CDR), progress reviews, acceptance tests and delivery milestones.
Own the contractual scope - specifications, statements of work and acceptance criteria - and manage scope changes, engineering changes and contractual correspondence.
Build and maintain the project plan (scope, schedule, budget, risks) and track execution against contractual milestones and deliverables.
Define phase-gate deliverables and ensure design review packages, test reports, qualification and acceptance documentation are produced at the right phase.
Coordinate the internal project team and cross-functional departments; direct the Project Engineer in day-to-day follow-up.
Manage the supplier side of the project: subcontracted components, subsystems and test services, from requirement definition to delivery.
Plan prototype builds, testing (including MIL-STD-type qualification where applicable) and field trials; own the after-sales interface for delivered systems.
Report project status, KPIs and risks to management and support proposal preparation together with Business Development.
What We Are Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering.
Minimum 6 years of experience in a defense or automotive industry environment, including at least 3 years managing technical projects end-to-end.
Hands-on experience in defense industry programs, within a prime contractor or as a subcontractor.
Track record of managing multi-phase projects with contractual milestones, acceptance criteria and penalty clauses.
Confident in leading design reviews, acceptance meetings and contractual discussions with customers.
Strong command of project management practices; proficiency in MS Project or an equivalent tool.
Working knowledge of hydraulic and/or pneumatic systems and mechanical design documentation, sufficient to lead engineering discussions.
Excellent written and spoken Turkish and English.
No travel restrictions; eligible for the personnel security clearance required for defense projects; military service completed or deferred (for male candidates).
A plus:
Master's degree or MBA; PMP/IPMA/PRINCE2; AQAP 2110/2310 or AS 9100, MIL-STD qualification and configuration management experience; PLM/PDM and APQP/PPAP experience; experience with hydraulic, pneumatic or thermal systems on land or naval platforms.
What We Offer
Real ownership: you run the project and represent the company to the customer, with direct access to senior management and short decision paths.
A growing system business backed by close to 40 years of engineering heritage, a government-certified R Center and a new production facility under construction.
Design, analysis, electronics, workshop and testing under one roof - and a say in how the department's project processes are built.
Long-term programs with Türkiye's leading defense industry OEMs.
